function.name: _READ
function.description: This function reads data from a GIF file into a buffer.

parameters.name: _gif
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file from which data is to be read.

parameters.name: _buf
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the buffer into which the data is to be read.

parameters.name: _len
parameters.description: This is the length of the data to be read from the GIF file.

function.return_type: int, represents the number of bytes read from the GIF file.

function.name: GetFileOffset
function.description: This function returns the offset of a given GIF file.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file for which the offset is to be obtained.

function.return_type: int, represents the offset of the GIF file

function.name: BitSize
function.description: This function calculates the minimum number of bits required to represent a given integer.

parameters.name: n
parameters.description: The integer to calculate the bit size for.

function.return_type: int, representing the minimum number of bits required to represent the input integer.

function.name: MakeMapObject
function.description: This function creates a new ColorMapObject and initializes it with the given color count and color map. If the color count is not a power of two, or if memory allocation fails, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: ColorCount
parameters.description: The number of colors to be included in the ColorMapObject. Must be a power of two.

parameters.name: ColorMap
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of GifColorType that represents the color map to be copied into the ColorMapObject. If NULL, the Colors field of the created object is initialized to zero.

function.return_type: ColorMapObject * - A pointer to the created ColorMapObject, or NULL if the creation failed.

function.name: FreeMapObject
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the ColorMapObject and its Colors attribute. There is a note to potentially change the function to accept a pointer to a pointer to a ColorMapObject and set it to NULL in the future.

parameters.name: Object
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the ColorMapObject that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: AddExtensionBlock
function.description: This function adds an extension block to the Extensions structure. It reallocates memory for the new block, sets the block's byte count and bytes, and copies the extension data into the block. If any memory allocation fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: New
parameters.description: Pointer to the Extensions structure where the new block will be added

parameters.name: Len
parameters.description: Length of the extension data

parameters.name: ExtData
parameters.description: Array containing the extension data to be added to the block

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the function execution. Returns GIF_OK if successful, GIF_ERROR if there is a memory allocation error

function.name: AppendExtensionBlock
function.description: This function appends an extension block to the existing ones. It reallocates memory for the new block, copies the extension data into the new block, and updates the byte count.

parameters.name: New
parameters.description: Pointer to the Extensions structure where the new block will be appended

parameters.name: Len
parameters.description: Length of the extension data

parameters.name: ExtData
parameters.description: Array containing the extension data to be appended

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: FreeExtension
function.description: This function frees up the memory allocated to the extension blocks within the Extensions object.

parameters.name: Extensions
parameters.description: Pointer to the Extensions object whose extension blocks need to be freed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything.

function.name: FreeSavedImages
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the saved images in the given GIF file.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file whose saved images are to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: DGifGetScreenDesc
function.description: This function retrieves the screen description from a GIF file. It reads the screen width, height, color resolution, background color, aspect ratio and color map from the file. If any error occurs during reading, it returns an error code.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file from which the screen description is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the operation. Returns GIF_OK if successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR.

function.name: DGifGetRecordType
function.description: This function reads a byte from the GifFile, and based on the value of the byte, it sets the Type to the corresponding record type. If the byte read is not one of the predefined values, it sets the Type to UNDEFINED_RECORD_TYPE and returns an error.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file from which a byte is read

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable where the record type will be stored

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the operation. Returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, and GIF_ERROR otherwise

function.name: DGifGetImageDesc
function.description: This function is used to get the image description from a GIF file. It reads the image's dimensions, checks if it has a local color map, and if it does, it reads the color map. It then reallocates memory for the image and saves the image description in the GIF file's SavedImages array.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file from which the image description is to be obtained.

function.return_type: int. This function returns GIF_OK if it successfully gets the image description, and GIF_ERROR if it encounters an error while getting the image description.

function.name: DGifGetLine
function.description: This function gets a line from a GIF file, decompresses it, and checks for errors. If the pixel count is zero, it cleans everything before returning.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description: Pointer to the line of pixels

parameters.name: LineLen
parameters.description: Length of the line

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: DGifGetExtension
function.description: This function reads the next extension block from the given GIF file, and returns the extension function code and the extension itself.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: A pointer to the GIF file from which to read the extension.

parameters.name: ExtCode
parameters.description: A pointer to an integer where the function will store the extension function code.

parameters.name: Extension
parameters.description: A pointer to a byte array where the function will store the extension.

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the operation. Returns GIF_ERROR if the read operation fails, otherwise the result of DGifGetExtensionNext function.

function.name: DGifGetExtensionNext
function.description: This function reads the next extension from the given GIF file and stores it in the provided extension buffer. If the read operation fails or there are no more extensions, it returns an error code.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: A pointer to the GIF file from which to read the extension.

parameters.name: Extension
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer where the read extension will be stored.

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: DGifGetWord
function.description: This function reads two bytes from the GifFile and stores the result in Word. It returns GIF_OK on success and GIF_ERROR on failure.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file from which two bytes are read

parameters.name: Word
parameters.description: Pointer to the variable where the result of the read operation is stored

function.return_type: int, represents the status of the operation, returning GIF_OK on success and GIF_ERROR on failure

function.name: DGifGetCodeNext
function.description: This function reads the next code block from a GIF file. If the block size is greater than 0, it reads the block into a private buffer and sets the CodeBlock pointer to this buffer. If the block size is 0, it sets the CodeBlock pointer to NULL and resets the private buffer and pixel count.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: A pointer to the GIF file structure

parameters.name: CodeBlock
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer, which will be set to point to the next code block

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if successful, or GIF_ERROR if an error occurs

function.name: DGifSetupDecompress
function.description: This function sets up the decompression for a GIF file. It initializes various properties of the file, reads the code size from the file, and sets up the prefix array.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GIF file that is to be decompressed.

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK on successful execution of the function

function.name: DGifDecompressLine
function.description: This function decompresses a line from a GIF file. It reads the GIF file, decodes the line items, and handles different codes such as EOFCode and ClearCode. It also manages a stack for the output stream.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file type

parameters.name: Line
parameters.description: Pointer to the pixel type of the line to be decompressed

parameters.name: LineLen
parameters.description: Length of the line to be decompressed

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: DGifGetPrefixChar
function.description: This function is used to get the prefix character from a GIF file. It iterates through the prefix until the code is less than or equal to the clear code or the maximum limit is reached.

parameters.name: Prefix
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the prefix type of the GIF.

parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: This is the code that is compared with the clear code.

parameters.name: ClearCode
parameters.description: This is the clear code that is compared with the code.

function.return_type: int, represents the final value of the code after the loop ends.

function.name: DGifDecompressInput
function.description: This function decompresses the input GIF file. It reads the input stream for the next code, checks if the code can fit into RunningBits bits, and raises its size if necessary.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file to be decompressed

parameters.name: Code
parameters.description: Pointer to the code that will be decompressed

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the decompression is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: DGifBufferedInput
function.description: This function reads the next buffer if the current one is empty, checks for any empty data blocks, reads the next data block if the current one is not empty, and updates the value of NextByte and Buf.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file from which data is read

parameters.name: Buf
parameters.description: Buffer used for reading data from the GIF file

parameters.name: NextByte
parameters.description: Pointer to the byte that will be read next

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise returns GIF_ERROR

function.name: DGifSlurp
function.description: This function reads a GIF file and stores the image data and any associated metadata in the GifFile structure.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: A pointer to a GifFileType structure, which will be filled with the image data and metadata from the GIF file.

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK if the function successfully reads the GIF file, and GIF_ERROR if an error occurs.

function.name: DGifOpen
function.description: This function opens a GIF file, checks if it is a valid GIF file, gets its screen description and returns a pointer to the file type. If any step fails, it cleans up and returns NULL.

parameters.name: userData
parameters.description: This parameter is used to store user data.

parameters.name: readFunc
parameters.description: This parameter is a function pointer used to read the GIF file.

function.return_type: GifFileType *, represents a pointer to the GIF file type. If the file could not be opened or is not a valid GIF file, NULL is returned.

function.name: DGifCloseFile
function.description: This function closes a GIF file, frees the memory allocated for the color maps and saved images, and releases the memory allocated for the GIF file itself.

parameters.name: GifFile
parameters.description: Pointer to the GIF file to be closed

function.return_type: int, returns GIF_OK on successful closure, GIF_ERROR if the GifFile pointer is NULL
